clock_hz.source: the shell clock (docs/f2.md); to verify in M3 (one lane) and M9 (the whole design)

memory_clock_hz.source: HBM ports on the shell clock

macs_per_lane.source: docs/architecture.md, engine: 128 x 4 x 2 B = 1024 B/cycle, all 32 HBM ports at 250 MHz

accumulators.source: docs/architecture.md, engine: 4 multiply-adds x a 4-cycle loop (D-027)

issue_cycles.source: the controller reads a command and hands it over; the waits are counted apart (D-053); M7 measures it

engine_startup_cycles.source: per engine command that waits for an earlier result (D-042), weights or KV read ahead: the most a SmolLM2 engine command after the first took over its engine cycles (SCORES at positions 1023 and 8191; MATVECs 61), 128-lane RTL in simulation (reports/data/M5-engine.json, real); scenarios with other lanes or accumulators reuse it (estimate: its drain and final sum change with them)

vector_startup_cycles.source: from a vector command's start to its done, past its groups: the chain (50 cycles at MulRegs = 2) and the read and write; SmolLM2's whole decode step on rtl/vec_unit.sv at F2's read latency (also for writes), positions 0, 63, 1023 and 8191, every command of its kind the same (scripts/measure_m6.py latency, reports/data/M6.json)

reduction_tail_cycles.source: a reduction's last row: its partials' last sums and the tree (D-050, one adder), past vector_startup_cycles; measured as vector_startup_cycles

reduction_row_cycles.source: a reduction's rows end at least this far apart: a row's last group waits for the tree to take the row before; measured as vector_startup_cycles

load_latency_cycles.source: from LOAD's start to its first beat: the address registered, F2's HBM read latency (70 cycles, docs/f2.md; our path's waits for M8; scenarios with another clock reuse it, an estimate: the memory's latency is in ns); measured as vector_startup_cycles

kv_store_latency_cycles.source: from KV_STORE's last beat leaving the chain to its last write answered (D-044), at the memory model's write latency of 70 cycles (F2's is not documented; M8; reused by scenarios with another clock, an estimate); measured as vector_startup_cycles

softmax_fused.source: D-054: softmax's subtraction, exp and sum in one vector pass, with an FP32 adder before and after each slot's chain; deferred (D-057)

max_in_drain.source: D-054: the engine keeps each score row's max as it writes it, so softmax has no MAX pass; deferred (D-057)

kv_tiles_shared.source: Q-27: a K or V tile serves every query head of its group; not planned
